examples.arabic: بالليل، كلوا عشا لذيذ عملته ماما في المطبخ.
examples.english: At night, they ate a delicious dinner that Mom made in the kitchen.
examples.transliteration: Bel leil, kalou 3asha laziz 3amalto Mama fel matbakh.

examples.english: The food is very delicious and a lot.
examples.transliteration: El akl lazeez awi w keteer.

examples.english: The food turned out very delicious.

examples.arabic: ماما عملت أكل لذيذ وقعدنا كلنا على الكراسي
examples.english: Mom made delicious food, and we all sat on the chairs.
examples.transliteration: Mama 3amalet akl laziz w qa3adna kollena 3ala el karasi.

examples.english: When we tasted it, we found it very delicious.

examples.arabic: لما روحت البيت ماما عملت اكل مصري لذيذ
examples.english: When I went home, mom made delicious Egyptian food
examples.transliteration: Lamma roht el beet mama 'amelet akl Masri lazeez
